title: Clan
body:
Syntax: clan join <clan name>

Description: Clan selection is required when creating a character. Choose one of your village's listed clans; blank answers and 'none' are not accepted. You can switch later with clan join <clan name>, but cannot leave without choosing another clan. Changing clans does not reroll inherited bloodlines or reincarnation. Existing clanless characters can use clan join to choose a clan.

Date: 2026-10-12
